title: Killer Klause: A Light at the North Pole
status: Creator origin adapted to proposed cutscene captions

panels.caption: Before Earthior fell, he was a Navy SEAL medic. His mission was to bring people home.
panels.beat: Adult medic kneels beside a survivor as the asteroid appears over Earthior.

panels.caption: Then the asteroid struck. The world broke, and the Void opened beneath him.
panels.beat: Earthior's horizon fractures; medic falls into a violet dimensional tear.

panels.caption: He fell out of the darkness above the North Pole—and straight through a workshop roof.
panels.beat: North Pole arrival and crash through the snowy workshop roof.

panels.caption: Bruised and bleeding, he searched the wreckage. Most of the workshop had fallen silent. Santa had not survived.
panels.beat: Wounded medic, broken toy benches, a covered still figure, and Santa's fallen hat.

panels.caption: Among the ruins, he found Santa's hat. He put it on.
panels.beat: Kneeling medic lifts the red hat onto his head.

panels.caption: Power surged through him. The mantle of Santa Claus had found its next guardian.
panels.beat: Warm gold and icy turquoise magic transforms medic into muscular Santa.

panels.caption: Then came a rumble beneath the wreckage. Someone was still alive.
panels.beat: New Santa turns toward a small elf hand emerging beneath a fallen beam.

panels.caption: He lifted the beams and treated the survivors. Before he was Santa, he was a medic.
panels.beat: Killer Klause rescues two elves and bandages one elf's arm.

panels.caption: Together, they gave the workshop a new purpose. The next delivery would fight back.
panels.beat: Elves and Klause assemble a ribbon-wrapped present rocket launcher at a toy workbench; proposed connective scene.

panels.caption: Killer Klause set out to learn what happened to Earthior—and stand against the Void.
panels.beat: Klause and elves step from workshop toward a violet rift, gift launcher ready.

panels.caption: He found X-God and the crew. They had lost the same home. They would face the darkness together.
panels.beat: Klause meets the lime-haired X-God; no claims about the fates of X-God's parents.

panels.caption: A new Santa. The same mission: protect the people who still need him.
panels.beat: Klause launches a wrapped present at Void creatures while X-God and the elves stand with him.
